sections.title: Past simple events
sections.body:
Regular verbs normally take -ed in affirmative past statements. Frequent irregular verbs use their own past forms.

• We walked to the station yesterday.
• She bought the final ticket last night.

title: Did in past questions and negatives

sections.title: Did in past questions and negatives
sections.body:
Use did or didn't before the base form for past questions and negatives. A main verb with did has no past ending.

sections.title: Going to for intentions
sections.body:

sections.title: Offers and instant decisions
sections.body:
Use I'll plus a base verb to offer help or announce a decision made at the moment of speaking. Will does not change with the subject.

Когда решение принято в ответ на ситуацию, естественно I'll. После will не нужны to, -s или форма прошедшего времени.

title: Comparative adjectives

sections.title: Comparative adjectives
sections.body:
Compare two things with a comparative adjective and than. Use -er with many short adjectives and more with longer ones.

Чтобы сравнить два объекта, выберите -er или more, затем than. Для good сравнительная форма better, для bad — worse.

sections.title: Frequency adverbs in routines

sections.title: Advice and obligation
